WITH tallies AS (
  SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
shares AS (
  SELECT status, tally, CAST(tally AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
  FROM tallies
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.status, s.tally, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_avg_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
